remarks: Escape to your own slice of paradise with this unique and inviting property featuring a pond so large it feels more like your own personal lake. From the back deck, you can relax and take in peaceful views of the water, surrounding scenery, aquatic life, and visiting wildlife, creating the perfect setting for quiet mornings, evening sunsets, or weekend unwinding. Inside, the open-concept layout allows natural light and beautiful views to flow through the main living areas, while the glowing woodstove in the living room adds warmth, charm, and cozy ambiance. The main floor offers easy one-floor living with two bedrooms and two full bathrooms, making this home a wonderful option for those just starting out, downsizing, or searching for a spectacular weekend retreat. The home also offers impressive additional potential in the basement, which features a second kitchen, full bathroom, family room with woodstove, utility room, and two bonus rooms that could lend themselves well to added living space, guest quarters, an in-law setup, or apartment-style use with the proper approvals. Radiant ceiling heat provides an innovative and comfortable heating concept, and the home is serviced by municipal water for added convenience. Peaceful, scenic, flexible, and full of possibility, this Belfast property is a rare opportunity to enjoy country-style living with water views, wildlife, and room to grow!
